remediation.evidence_role: Local kosha_guide items remain supporting; directEligible is metadata only.
remediation.risk_rows: KOSHA guide items cannot independently create risk rows from evidenceRef and may only attach a supporting page reference to a row grounded by a non-KOSHA reference.
remediation.retrieval_mode: Mode is derived from final returned sources and preserves rest-ilike, ranked-rpc, or hybrid-vector-rpc when no local item survives.
remediation.item_type: The local itemType predicate is applied before scoring and limit.
remediation.row_specific_relevance: Supporting KOSHA attaches only when its recognized risk domain matches the direct row or at least two non-generic identity terms overlap. Generic terms such as 작업, 안전, and 관리 do not establish relevance.

per_row_cap.rationale: Preserves a primary guide plus one complementary source without turning one direct row into a broad bibliography.

remediation.deduplication: Supporting KOSHA evidenceRef values are deduplicated before the per-row cap.

invalidated_expanded_attempt.reason: An over-broad evidence_role filter blocked five established non-KOSHA SIF risk-row tests.

p1_row_relevance_red.test: caps row-specific supporting KOSHA and rejects broad or duplicate evidence refs
